answer: Require every agent to post a small refundable stake before transacting, tied to a slowly earned reputation record. Like tending an orchard, standing grows only through useful work attested by peers, while a ferrous checkpoint — a bonded identity backed by scarce stake — makes each new identity costly to create. A genuine signal such as a completed job is cheap for one real agent, but an attacker must pay the stake and build history for every fake identity, so a Sybil flood costs far more than it can gain.
